answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 96 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a gale bet on surviving 96 epochs of grading, and every raven settlement recomputes the plume schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
